Ek majboor insaan naye kshitij banata hai.
Jigyasa duniya ka kinaara dhoondh leti hai.
Vichaar aatma ki boli hai.
Ek mazak nafrat ki sabse badi khaai ko jod sakta hai.
Ichchha sabhi moorhon ka pita hai.
Rooh yaadon ke mahalon mein naachti hai.
Dar Senate ke dhol se zyada zor se gungunata hai.
Ghamand sabse bade dimaag ki tabaahi hai.
Do baar maapo, ek baar kaato.
Agyan sabse tez bole.
Dard aatma ka chhaani hai.
Jeb munh mein rakhi tez talwar hai.
Vyang andheri khopadi me roshni ki chamak hai.
Gehre andhere mein taare sabse jyada chamkate hain.
Teekha jawab chatur ka kavach hota hai.
Rooh khud ko dhoondne ke liye akelapan chahti hai.
Prem ek divy paagalpan hai.
Garibi darshan ki bahan hai.
Vyang oonchi aatma ka disha suchak hai.
Ahankar wo langar hai jo chattan par ghiste hai.
Hum andar basne wali cheezon ko rokne ke liye deewar banate hain.
Dukh ki jad apeksha hai.
Manushya bhramon ka shikari hai.
Pahad ko suno, hawa ko nahi.
Chalak dimaag qabr mein bhi roshni dhoondh leta hai.
Buddhi moorkhata ko dikhane wala aaina hai.
Hum jeevan ki yatra anumanon ke samudra par karte hain.
Rooh chup chaap raaton mein apne raaz tolti hai.
Dil waqt ke safar ko chunauti deta hai.
Khud ko jaanana hi devataon par vijay hai.
Aatma ka saamaan uske pachtave se naapa jata hai.
Dimaag ek aisi riyasat hai jahan parchhaiyon ka raaj hai.
Kadhai se nikal kar aag mein girna.
Buddhi bezubaanon ki dhaal hai.
Jaise hum aage badhte hain, dimaag ka kshitij peeche hatta hai.
Log mahatvakanksha ki bina tal ki khai me doobte hain.
Ghamand girne se pehle taakatwar ko andha kar deta hai.
Tohfe mein mile ghode ke daant nahi ginne chahiye.
Dar tark ki aankh ko andha kar deta hai.
Log satya khojte hain, par bhram ko apnate hain.
Hum hawa ke peeche bhagte hain aur sirf dhool paate hain.
Jo khud ki seva kare, uska maalik bura hota hai.
Khwahish insaan ko anjaane samandar paar karwa deti hai.
Shabd beej hain; dhyan se bo-o.
Moorhta ek bhari bojh hai.
Bina gyan ki chaturai zehrile teer jaisi hai.
Azaad insaan kisi ka gulam nahi hota.
Gyan sadagi ka chola pehenta hai.
Tark darshanik ka kavach hai.
Sankhyaayein brahmand par raj kare.
Jeevan ek natak hai; apana kirdar achhe se nibhao.
